home.heroTitle: Learn every subject, from grade 1 to 12
home.heroText: Complete courses in Math, Algebra, Geometry, Physics, Drawing and Languages, built on the Armenian and Russian school curricula and available in English, Armenian and Russian.
home.curriculumText: Every course explains how the topic is taught in Armenia and in Russia, so pupils, parents and teachers in either system can follow along.

exam.title: Exams
exam.intro: Practice for the real thing: the Armenian state final and unified exams, the Russian ОГЭ and ЕГЭ, and a year-end trial test for every course. All questions are original, written in the style of the real papers, and come with explanations.

systemText.armenia: Final assessments by the Assessment and Testing Centre (ԳԹԿ): grade 4 knowledge check, grade 9 final exams, grade 12 state finals and the unified university entrance exams. Results on the 20-point scale.
systemText.russia: State final attestation set by ФИПИ: the ОГЭ after grade 9 and the ЕГЭ after grade 11. Results converted to the familiar 5-point mark.

exam.trialsText: One practice test per subject and grade. Take it in May to see whether the year's material is really yours.
exam.courseSectionText: Check the whole year in exam mode: a year-end trial and, where it exists, the state exam for this subject.
